entrada.titulo: Privacy-preserving vaccine supply chain management leveraging blockchain and self-sovereign identity

perfil_anterior.problema: drug and vaccine supply chain counterfeiting emerged as a serious threat
perfil_anterior.solucao: emerging technologies such as blockchain and Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) have gained attention for improving the efficiency, transparency, and security of vaccine supply chain management
perfil_anterior.avaliacao: empirical results prove the efficacy of the proposed supply chain framework
perfil_anterior.limites: scalability issues, interoperability constraints, and privacy concerns
perfil_anterior.possibilidades: Integrar edge computing para verificação em tempo real da autenticidade dos lotes de vacina nas fronteiras da cidade inteligente.; Combinar SSI com criptografia baseada em atributos (ABE) para controle de acesso granular a dados de rastreamento.; Avaliar a interoperabilidade entre plataformas municipais de saúde e provedores de identidade descentralizada.; Desenvolver mecanismos de revogação distribuída de credenciais SSI via contratos inteligentes.; Aplicar a abordagem a sensores IoT de monitoramento de temperatura e localização na cadeia de frio de vacinas.

In view of these factors, the need for effective vaccine distribution 
cannot be overemphasized. Using innovative technology like 
blockchain provides an opportunity to expedite distribution 
processes, improve accountability, and strengthen healthcare 
systems in the face of future pandemics and public health 
emergencies. Blockchain technology provides several advantages 
that can considerably improve COVID-19 vaccine delivery methods. 
Blockchain has the potential to facilitate equitable and effective 
vaccine delivery by enhancing transparency, traceability, efficiency, 
and safety, ultimately helping global efforts to combat the epidemic 
and protect public health.
Novelty and Contributions Beyond Blockchain-Only Vaccine 
Supply Chains:
Existing blockchain-based vaccine supply chain solutions 
primarily focus on immutable record-keeping, transaction 
transparency, and batch-level traceability. While these approaches 
improve auditability and counterfeit detection, they largely rely on 
identity-agnostic or centrally managed identity models, where 
stakeholders are authenticated through predefined roles or 
platform-specific accounts. Such designs limit privacy preservation, 
cross-organizational interoperability, and fine-grained access 
control, particularly in multi-country and multi-regulator vaccine 
ecosystems.
The proposed framework advances the state of the art by tightly 
integrating Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) with blockchain-
based traceability, enabling decentralized, privacy-preserving, and 
verifiable identity management across the entire vaccine supply 
chain. Unlike blockchain-only systems, where identities are 
implicitly trusted or centrally provisioned, our approach allows each 
stakeholder—manufacturers, distributors, healthcare centers, and 
clinics to operate using verifiable credentials (VCs) bound to 
decentralized identifiers (DIDs) issued by trusted authorities.
A key novelty of the proposed system lies in decoupling identity 
verification from on-chain transactions. Identity validation, 
selective disclosure, and revocation checks are performed off-chain 
using SSI mechanisms, while the blockchain is used exclusively for 
anchoring cryptographic proofs, custody events, and immutable 
audit logs. This design significantly reduces on-chain data exposure,

resposta.resumo: O trecho descreve como a integração de blockchain com Self‑Sovereign Identity (SSI) pode melhorar a rastreabilidade, transparência e privacidade na cadeia de suprimentos de vacinas, reduzindo a exposição de dados on‑chain e permitindo verificação descentralizada de credenciais. Destaca ainda que soluções anteriores baseadas apenas em blockchain dependem de identidades centralizadas, limitando a interoperabilidade e o controle de acesso fino.

perfil.solucao: integrating Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) with blockchain-based traceability
perfil.limites: identity-agnostic or centrally managed identity models
perfil.possibilidades:
• Integrar computação de borda para verificação em tempo real da autenticidade dos lotes nas fronteiras da cidade inteligente.
• Combinar SSI com criptografia baseada em atributos (ABE) para controle de acesso granular aos dados de rastreamento.
• Avaliar a interoperabilidade entre plataformas municipais de saúde e provedores de identidade descentralizada usando padrões de credenciais verificáveis.
• Implementar revogação distribuída de credenciais SSI via contratos inteligentes.
• Aplicar a arquitetura a sensores IoT de monitoramento de temperatura e localização na cadeia de frio das vacinas.
• Explorar provas de conhecimento zero‑knowledge para reforçar a privacidade nas auditorias on‑chain.
